description: Community fixes merged into magento/magento2 after a release line was cut, with per-version applicability from git apply checks; not Adobe Quality Patches, for those use find_patch. Get one upstream fix by id (e.g. "magento2-40867") with its pull request, linked issues, first release containing it, per-tag code match, affected versions, touched packages and files, labels and triage scores. Pass version, and optionally distribution, to get the code match for that version and the Composer bundle URL when the fix applies to it.

distribution.description: Optional distribution for installation, default magento-community

version.description: Optional version: adds the code match for that version and the Composer bundle URL, or install null when the fix does not apply to it

name: get_upstream_fix
